SPECIAL MEETING AGENDA
CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
AND THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
THURSDAY - JUNE 3, 2021 - 07:00 P.M.
ZOOM VIDEO COMMUNICATIONS, MEETING ID # 899 2849 2367
LEGISLATIVE BODY MEMBERS AND THE PUBLIC MAY PARTICIPATE FROM THE CITY COUNCIL CHAMBER, 18125 BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, OR VIA TELECONFERENCE AUTHORIZED BY STATE OF CALIFORNIA EXECUTIVE ORDERS N-25-20 AND N-29-20
*COVID-19 NOTICE*
To protect public health and safety during the local, state, and federally declared COVID-19 emergency, and in compliance with the current Los Angeles County Health Officer Order, the City Council Chamber will be open to the public subject to Los Angeles County mandated COVID-19 protocols. As authorized by State of California Executive Orders N-25-20 and N-29-20 this meeting will also be conducted via teleconference. Public observation and participation in this meeting will be facilitated through the methods described below.
Agenda Materials
The complete agenda for this meeting is available on-demand at www.cerritos.us and at the Office of the City Clerk, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, 1st floor, Cerritos, CA, during regular business hours (Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., weekend and observed holidays excepted). Any materials submitted to the legislative body after the distribution of this agenda will be available for public inspection in the Office of the City Clerk during regular business hours. Requests for agenda materials or meeting participation assistance can also be made by email to city_clerk@cerritos.us or by phone at (562) 916-1248 during regular business hours.
PUBLIC OBSERVATION AND PARTICIPATION
The public can observe the meeting via livestream on the City’s website at www.cerritos.us, on cable television at Cerritos TV3, by connecting to the ZOOM meeting described below, or in-person subject to posted COVID-19 protocols.
Public Comments
Members of the public may provide public comment for this meeting in-person at the meeting or by using any of the following alternate methods:
Written correspondence (hard copy or email): Public comments can be submitted via email to city_clerk@cerritos.us or by hard copy to the Office the City Clerk no later than 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Please identify the agenda item number in the subject line of the email or hard copy document. All written correspondence received by the 3:00 p.m. deadline will be distributed to the legislative body prior to the meeting. During the meeting, your name and summary comments will be read into the record. The document will be retained with the public record of the meeting.
Teleconference Participation: Live audio public comments can be made by connecting to the meeting using the information listed below. Public speakers will be queued to provide comment at the appropriate time during the meeting agenda and must be available at the time they are called upon to speak.
Cerritos Zoom meeting online link: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/89928492367
Cerritos Zoom Meeting call-in telephone number: (669) 900-6833
Cerritos Zoom Meeting ID: 899 2849 2367
Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accommodations
In compliance with the ADA, any person with a disability who requires accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the Office of the City Clerk at (562) 916-1248 to request accommodation. The City will use its best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations related to the teleconference meeting.

minutes_text:
MINUTES OF A SPECIAL MEETING OF THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR
AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY HELD THURSDAY, JUNE 3, 2021,
7:00 P.M., IN HYBRID MODE FROM THE COUNCIL CHAMBER, 18125 BLOOMFIELD
AVENUE, CERRITOS, CA AND VIA TELECONFERENCE AS AUTHORIZED BY STATE OF
CALIFORNIA EXECUTIVE ORDERS N-25-20 AND N-29-20, VIA ZOOM VIDEO
COMMUNICATIONS, MEETING ID# 899 2849 2367

1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.

2.  Pledge of Allegiance

  The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Mayor Grace Hu.

3.  Roll Call

  The following members of the City Council/Successor Agency were in attendance:

  Council/Agency Member Bruce Barrows
  Council/Agency Member Naresh Solanki
  Council/Agency Member Frank A. Yokoyama
  Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair Chuong Vo
  Mayor/Chair Grace Hu

4.  Review and consideration of the Fiscal Year 2021-22 preliminary Combined
  Financial Program for the City of Cerritos and the Successor Agency to the
  Cerritos Redevelopment Agency (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  Staff reports were given by Jeff Thielke, Budget Manager, and Ken Pun, the City’s
  budget/financial consultant. A PowerPoint presentation was displayed.

  CONSENSUS (Barrows): Directed the City Manager to set up the appropriate system
  to attribute costs for staff working outside of their assigned Department to the actual
  Department for which they are providing services in future budgets and budget reports.

  The Mayor opened the public comments period.

  Written correspondence:
  (Written correspondence is considered public record and full-text copies of submitted
  written correspondence can be obtained in the Office of the City Clerk/Treasurer)

  George Catrell submitted written correspondence expressing support for allocating
  additional funds for pine tree removal.

  Teddy Lloyd submitted written correspondence expressing support for allocating funds to
  expand the City’s pickleball facilities.

  Alejandro Estella submitted written correspondence inquiring whether the City will be
  making changes to its monthly mileage allowance benefit program.

  Audio public comments:

  Teddy Lloyd suggested the City Council consider expansion of the City’s pickleball
  facilities and provided two options for creating more pickle ball courts.

  Elena (last name not provided) expressed support for expansion of the City’s pickleball
  facilities.
 City of Cerritos  Thursday, June 3, 2021, 7:00 p.m.
City Council/Successor Agency Special Meeting  Page 2 of 2

4.  (continued)

  Ray (last name indecipherable) expressed support for expansion of the City’s pickleball
  facilities and displayed medals won by residents in pickleball tournaments.

  Noting there were no other individuals who provided written correspondence or elected
  to speak, the Mayor declared the public comments period closed.

  MOTION: It was moved by Solanki, and seconded by Hu, to allocate a total amount of
  $40,000 in funding support to the Chamber of Commerce in the Fiscal Year 2021-22 budget
  with acknowledgement that this funding will not be utilized for the salaries of Chamber
  of Commerce staff or any other private entities (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Solanki, Yokoyama, Vo, Hu
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

  CONSENSUS (Vo): Directed the City Manager to change the column title in the final
  Fiscal Year 2021-22 budget document and in future budget documents and reports from
  “EST. ACTUAL” to “ESTIMATED.”

  CONSENSUS (Vo): Directed the City Manager to add a second “actual” column (for a
  total of two columns) for each budget line item to reference the actual expenditures
  from the previous two completed fiscal years in the final Fiscal Year 2021-22 budget
  document and in future budget documents and reports.

  CONSENSUS (Barrows): Directed the City Manager to set up a special fund as
  recommended by the City’s budget/financial consultant to accurately track eligible
  expenditures to be paid with American Rescue Plan Act of 2021 revenues received by
  the City in the final Fiscal Year 2021-22 budget document and in future budget
  documents and reports.

5.  Adjournment

  The meeting adjourned at 10:06 p.m.

  /s/Vida Barone_______________ ______
  Vida Barone, City Clerk/Agency Secretary
